title: DIO option-mismatch rejection fails to consume network replay high-water
description: Fresh final timing correctness review: StratumTracker._adopt_locked checks caller DioTimeOption equality before advancing the authenticated network replay high-water. A sample rejected with a mismatched option consumes only that sample issuance; DioTimeVerifier can reissue from the same sealed authenticated DIO/counter, and a later matching option is then adopted. Advance signer/generation/counter consideration barriers before every semantic rejection, including option mismatch, or make DIO-to-time issuance one-use. Test mismatch→reverify same counter, mismatch→fresh higher counter, repeated verify, and no regression of direct evidence.
